name: Rapa Nui (Easter Island, Chile)
description: A white field charged at the centre with a red reimiro — the crescent-shaped Rapa Nui pectoral ornament with a human face at each tip.
history: Te Reva Reimiro, the flag of Easter Island and the Rapa Nui people, first hoisted in the 19th century as a mark of the island's identity and officially adopted by the commune in 2006. The reimiro is the wooden breast ornament worn by Rapa Nui nobility; in red it evokes chiefly power (mana).

features.role: reimiro pectoral with a face at each tip
features.symbolism: the chiefly ornament of Rapa Nui nobility — authority and mana
